content.key_idea: T10 turns a DNN model into compute-shift execution plans via the rTensor abstraction, selects Pareto-optimal plans per operator and then holistically across operators to balance memory and inter-core communication, before mapping the result to device kernel code.

evidence: We present the overview of T10 in Figure 4
T10 introduces the RotatingTensor (rTensor) abstraction to represent the partitioning and communication patterns
The plan is compiled onto the processor using three abstracted device interfaces

summary: T10 is a DL compiler that exploits inter-core communication bandwidth and distributed on-chip memory on chips like the Graphcore IPU. Figure 4 gives the system overview as four color-coded, labeled quadrants tied to paper subsections. Top-left, a DNN model is turned into compute-shift execution plans via the rTensor abstraction (§4.1-4.2), shown with an example Op 0 plan. Top-right, an intra-operator tradeoff stage selects Pareto-optimal plans balancing memory and execution time, distinguishing best from bad plans (§4.3.1). Bottom-right, an inter-operator tradeoff stage performs holistic end-to-end plan selection minimizing total SRAM idle time across operators (§4.3.2). Bottom-left, the chosen plan is mapped through hardware abstraction interfaces (allocate/compute/shift) into generated device code such as IPU_code.cpp (§4.4). The figure is very densely packed, drawn in drawio style with many small colored boxes and code snippets.
summary_zh: 图4以四个按小节编号、颜色区分的象限展示T10编译器架构：DNN模型经rTensor转为计算-移位执行计划，再分别做算子内（时间-内存权衡）和算子间（SRAM空闲最小化）的方案选择，最终经硬件抽象映射生成设备代码，图中信息密度很高。
notes: The body text describes the four design stages generally but does not spell out every box label seen in this dense drawio diagram; some component names/roles are inferred primarily from the figure.
